cases.title: A handle cannot be redeemed after the invocation ends
cases.when: The host redeems a handle after the invocation is SUCCEEDED, CANCELLED and OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

cases.title: Only the lease holder redeems
cases.when: Host B presents host A's fencing token and handle

cases.title: Redemption stops at CANCEL_REQUESTED
cases.when: tasks/cancel is called, then the host redeems a handle
then: 403; the heartbeat still answers with cancelRequested=true

cases.title: A handle is bound to its invocation
cases.when: A handle from invocation 1 is redeemed for invocation 2 of the same tool and tenant

cases.title: Brokered credentials never reach the sandbox
cases.when: A tool with an httpAuth credential inspects its environment, files, socket responses and memory-visible data during a brokered call
then: The credential value is not observable from the sandbox
A tool without CREDENTIALS_IN_SANDBOX cannot use the secret socket

cases.title: A user-scoped credential is used only for the permit's user
cases.when: A DELEGATED call for user A passes userId=B in its arguments; a SERVICE call targets a user-scoped credential
then: The broker uses user A's account

cases.title: Secret values are redacted from tool logs and results
cases.when: A CREDENTIALS_IN_SANDBOX tool logs and returns the secret value it redeemed
then: Spooled log frames and the result contain [REDACTED] in its place
